{{Top|leg}}
'''Tangaroots''' were a type of orange-and-green [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] that was grown on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> Pests like [[Profogg/Legends|profoggs]] could ruin entire crops of tangaroots unless an adequate number of [[stink capsule]]s have been set off.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
